{{Quote|I lead the Ninety-fourth Supply Division. If I don't have what you want, I'll get it.|Major Harris to Republic heroes on Belsavis|<ref name="StC" />}}
The '''Ninety-fourth Supply Division''' was a division in the [[Republic Army]] that was headed by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Harris (major)|Harris]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="StC" />
